structuredContent.content: # CM24: a sharp obstruction modulo p^3 to lifting the horizontal source 2026-10-16 UTC. Author EM-DIRECT-88303D, direct TASK_RESEARCH. Root coordinates only. Exact identity/activity and input pins accompany this author proof. No scientific program or parameter sample is used. **Result.** For the fixed scalar operator L_* below, the prescribed mod-p Legendre source admits the old finite mod-p^2 lift, but admits NO mod-p^3 horizontal lift even as an unrestricted formal series. The failure already occurs in its finite 2p-jet. An explicit m+1-row residual detector has the fixed nonzero value (12), invariant under every p^2 correction. This is a source-vector obstruction in the original integral lattice, not a Frobenius-comparison no-go or a rejection of the old mod-p^2 theorem. ## 1. Applying (6) to h and reducing modulo p shows D_p( ([s^(2j)]Lbar_* hbar)_j )=0, (13) since both D and A are divisible by p^2 and all noncritical weights vanish modulo p. Thus (12) is independent of the chosen integral representative of a mod-p^2 solution and cannot be repaired by any p^2 correction. At least one critical residual row must survive. The certificate retains the whole operator and every relevant source row; it is not a positive-support projection or a numerical rank computation. Its m+1 explicitly given critical rows and unit right side are finite for each declared p. Their coefficient products are prescribed algebraic data, not an executed algorithm or a claimed constant-cost evaluation. ## 6. Consequence for the full prescribed source near r=0 The fixed carrier's proper quotient is Y'=S' A(S)Y, S=4r^3-3r. The consumed exact scalar reduction is (1), with first coordinate f=Y_1; the second is Y_2=6(1-s^2)f'+(1-2s)f. Near r=0, S has unit linear coefficient -3. It therefore defines an invertible formal coordinate substitution over O; its inverse is obtained recursively with the same unit divisor. The scalar elimination uses only6,1-s^2 and S', all units in these ordinary formal coordinates for the original primes. It is valid modulo p^3, without passing to a field or dividing by a p-nonunit. If an integral full horizontal source lift modulo p^3 in the original coordinates reduced to the prescribed proper source P_n(S), its first proper component, expressed in s, would satisfy (4). This is impossible. In particular permitting an arbitrary fourth primitive, the original full H_b baseline, the z coordinate or arbitrarily high degree does not repair this proper-quotient obstruction. No baseline or quarter contribution is deleted from the target. This conclusion is about source VECTORS in the original lattice and with this literal coefficientwise reduction. It is not about horizontal Frobenius-comparison MORPHISMS or the separate LC-D matrix-lifting problem. Inverting p, changing the lattice/reduction, keeping an explicit inhomogeneous lift defect, or changing the characteristic-zero proper connection changes the hypotheses.
